Uses sub_588410, which returns 0 on a string match, in a cascading chain: the first category pointer off_5D6FD4 maps to 32.5, Warm to 26.25, Medium to 20.0, Cool to 13.75, Cold to a value computed by sub_58850F, and any unmatched name falls through to the default 7.5. If sub_588410 returns 0 (match on the first category), return 32.5.
Compare a1 against the Warm category string aWarm.
If the Warm category matches, return 26.25.
Compare a1 against the Medium category string aMedium.
If the Medium category matches, return 20.0.
Compare a1 against the Cool category string aCool.
If the Cool category matches, return 13.75.
Compare a1 against the Cold category string aCold.
When a1 matches the Cold category, compute the value by calling sub_58850F(a1) and return it.
Fall back to the default value 7.5 when no category matched.
